title_zh: 区分虚构裁定与尚未决定的处罚

scenario.label_zh: 虚构法院材料中的裁定与处罚
scenario.goal_zh: 核对重新举行听证的裁定并注明处罚尚未决定

context_zh: 课堂英语练习：Tariq 与 Lena 阅读一份完全虚构的法院案例摘要，不讨论现实诉讼或提供法律意见。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: I’ve put “the company must pay a fine” in our summary of the ruling.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Does the text say that? The supreme court of Lydora orders a new hearing, not a payment.

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: You’re right. The final paragraph says the sanction has not been decided.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Then we should separate those two points in our notes.

sentences.speaker: Tariq
sentences.text: I’ll write “new hearing ordered” and “penalty still undecided.”

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: That matches the case sheet. Let’s use those two lines.
